messages:
Nora: Quick sync 10min: We're running a focused mini-sprint to update migration guides for v1 -> v2 and replace a few fragile SDK snippets. Goal: land small, well-tested PRs by EOD Fri.
Evan: Sounds good. I'll handle Python snippets + the curl examples that are used in blog posts.
Priya: I'll do the guide copy edits and add an explicit 'what breaks' FAQ section. Can we also add a short section on model swap regression checks?
Nora: Yes. Add a checklist item: how to pin old behavior with aliasing and when to rollback to a compatible model.
Marco: Heads up  a11y/UX note: update screenshots that show the old UI param `invoke`. I'll take the screenshots after the docs text changes land.
Evan: Found 9 MD files that reference `client.invoke` and 6 snippets in examples/. I can open tiny PRs for each.
Priya: For translations: we'll mark changed strings with `i18n:needs-review` so localization team picks them up.
Nora: Important: ensure all PR bodies contain a migration snippet block and a single-line migration summary for the release notes.
docs-bot: New checklist template created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/website/pull/8245 (template applies `docs/deprecation-mini` label).
Priya: Example migration blurb I propose:
```md
Old: `client.invoke({ model: 'r-instruct', prompt })`
New: `await client.responses.create({ model: 'r-instruct-2024-02', input: prompt })`
Notes: responses API returns structured output; if you need plain text use the helper `docs.utils.extractText(res)` or iterate `res.output[0].content`.
```
Evan: For curl examples, we should normalize JSON shapes. Proposed replacement:
```bash
# OLD
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke -d '{"model":"r-instruct","prompt":"hi"}'
# NEW
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"r-instruct-2024-02","input":"hi"}'
```
Marco: Can we add a small JS helper snippet to make migration less noisy? e.g., `const text = extract(res)` so example authors don't have to show array traversal.
Nora: Agreed. Add helper to docs utils and reference it from snippets. Make sure helper is minimal and language-agnostic examples exist.
Legal: Please surface any privacy-sensitive changes. If examples include PII, we need a redaction note and to confirm retention policy.
Priya: Noted. I'll add a checkbox to the PR template: 'no real PII or secrets in examples'.
Evan: Smoke testing plan: 1) run doc build `yarn build`; 2) run `npm run snippet-verify` which executes snippets in a sandbox; 3) spot-check three endpoints for broken links.
Nora: Let's also update the deprecation notice copy in `/docs/news` with a short timeline and a link to the migration guide. Draft in PR #8250.
docs-bot: PRs opened: 6. CI pending. Labels added: `docs/deprecation-mini`, `needs-qa`.
Marco: UX: after merge, I'll upload new screenshots and request a small CSS tweak to keep code block heights consistent.
Evan: One gotcha I noticed: some examples assumed `res.output_text` as a top-level field. We should add a migration note: parse `res.output[0].content` and prefer helper functions.
Priya: Also adding a short snippet for model-swap: show how to set `model: 'r-instruct-2024-02'` and how to fallback to `r-instruct-2023-11` if the new variant reports higher latency.
Nora: Good. Add a tiny config example for rollouts (canary weight, fallback model). Keep it non-opinionated.
docs-bot: CI green on two PRs, 4 still running.
Evan: Merged 3 small PRs: python snippet fixes + two curl replacements. Updated the smoke test to catch `.text` usages.
Priya: Merged guide edits and the FAQ. Marked strings `i18n:needs-review`.
Legal: Reviewed the deprecation notice draft; minor wording suggestions posted on PR #8250.
Nora: Final items before closing: all PRs merged, snippet smoke tests passing, redirects validated for removed slugs, news deprecation notice live. I'll post a short thread in #general after deploy.
Marco: Taking screenshots now. Will attach to the merged PR for reference.
Evan: Smoke test results: one curl example failed due to missing header; filed PR fix.
Nora: Great work, team. We'll circle back next week for follow-ups. If anyone sees lingering `invoke` occurrences, drop them here and I'll reassign.
